design.setPiece: One continuous push from the person's face into one eye until the black pupil fills the frame.

lastFrame.shows: The black pupil fills the whole frame.

sound.prompt: The sound starts on the first frame: a full rush of air with a deep low tone under it, both rising and building as the camera dives into the eye.

prompt: One unbroken shot that moves from the first frame to the last, with no pause. From the first frame the camera pushes straight in toward one of the person's eyes, and it never slows down. The eye fills the frame, then the iris with its sharp fine fibres, then the black pupil. In the last second the black pupil grows outward until it swallows the whole frame, while the camera keeps moving in. The iris stays sharp and bright around the pupil until the pupil covers it.

midFrame.prompt: Change the photo into an extreme macro close-up of the iris of one of the person's eyes, so close that the iris fills the whole frame from edge to edge and no eyelid, eyelash or skin shows. The round black pupil sits in the centre. The fine fibres of the iris are sharp. The iris keeps the exact colour of the person's eyes in the photo.
